entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Damn Shadows... they've taken up[n]intercept positions!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like it's not about capturing us[n]anymore... They're out for blood!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll back you up, so fight like your life[n]depends on it! Let's go!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmph, I knew you were an amateur.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Strike at an enemy's weakness to[n]knock them down! Use that opening[n]to strike again!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's the most basic of basics![n]Remember it well!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: C'mon, let's hurry and get through this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And that's not all! Make an opening,[n]and you can do something like this[n]too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm entrusting you with this chance[n]to attack again!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No need to hold back—go for it!
